title: RigAnchor
description: A generic 'anchor' record: the single unifying primitive used by engine/rig.py for every point that must stay correctly positioned relative to its parent bone through arbitrary (including rotational, joint-limited) posing — muscle origins/insertions, tendon via-points, fascial entheses, nerve/vessel path via-points, and NMJ zones. Every anchor is expressed purely in its parent bone's LOCAL frame; global position at any pose is obtained by walking the kinematic chain's forward-kinematics transform (engine/rig.py:forward_kinematics) and is therefore always correct by construction, never re-fit after posing.

owner_entity.description: id of the muscle/fascia/nerve/vessel entity this anchor belongs to

parent_bone_frame.description: bone id supplying the local frame this anchor rides in

blend_weights.description: Optional dual/multi-bone skin weighting for anchors that sit over a joint (e.g. a via-point near a joint capsule that should blend between two adjacent segments' frames) — linear blend skinning per Magnenat-Thalmann et al. classic LBS formulation. Omitted (single-frame rigid) for the vast majority of anchors, which is anatomically correct since tendon/nerve/vessel attachment points are rigid to one bone.
